rationale: Paired with ⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲱⲟⲩ 'the dry one' as the wet/dry archonic pair under the Virgin of Light's judgment (l.28-29). Etymology unclear; possibly Lyc. for a moisture-root. Confidence moderate.

Lycopolitan reflex of ϫⲣⲟ 'overcome, prevail'. ⲁⲩⲇⲣⲟ ⲁⲣⲁϩ 'they prevailed over him' (l.4); qualitative ⲇⲣⲁⲓⲧ 'victorious' (l.15, 24) paired antithetically with ⲧⲁⲭⲁⲓⲧ 'destroyed' as the cosmic outcome-pair.

Title of the fifth judge, established in the seventh firmament. ⲛⲁⲇ = Lyc. ⲛⲟϭ 'great'; ⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ 'honor'. Standard Manichaean title for one of the cosmic governors, possibly the King of Glory (Saklas/the Just Ruler) of the firmaments.
Standard Manichaean title for the cosmic feminine figure (παρθένος τοῦ φωτός) who bore Adam's heart and judges in the wet/dry archons. Ninth of the cosmic judges. Identified here at K.80.25-26.
Form unclear. Context (multitude of archons of upper and lower regions) suggests a noun of agitation. Possibly Lyc. ⲃⲱⲧⲥ̄ or related to ⲡⲱⲣϣ̄ 'spread out'. Flag for parallels.
